title.narrative: BGK.ED-Sustaining Our Oceans in Ranong MAB

description.narrative:
First, to enhance the understanding of marine conservation education including the importance of reducing marine debris, among stakeholders of coastal and marine UNESCO designated sites (World Heritage, Biosphere Reserve, Global Geopark) in Thailand, the following activities would be conducted: • Conducting situation analysis on educational activities and materials for children and adolescents in UNESCO designated sites through consultations with national and local stakeholders • Conducting situation analysis on education about marine conservation in primary and secondary education schools around selected UNESCO designated sites
Next, to foster the capacity of young people in Thailand in understanding the impact of anthropogenic activities on the marine and coastal environment, the following activities would be conducted: • Developing at least three educational packages on marine conservation to be used in UNESCO designated sites for primary and secondary students through ideathon sessions and on-site testing of design prototypes by bringing designers, artists, ocean scientists, educationists, environmentalists and site managers together • Conducting trainings for site managers of UNESCO-designated sites to build their capacities to use the UNESCO sites as learning hubs for marine conservation and using the newly developed education materials • Conducting teacher's workshops to build their capacities on integrating marine conservation issues into school education by adapting newly developed education materials on marine conservation as well as available UNESCO knowledge products • Organising experiential learning activities for students using newly developed education materials on marine conservation combined with site visits to UNESCO designated sites (after the project)
